sections.title: Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
sections.text:
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
Invoicing and payables management in SAP S/4HANA is delivered by SAP to work
based on standard settings. However, to realize the full features and functionalities of
these capabilities in order to support the enterprise’s goals, the system can be fine-
tuned based on business requirements. This section provides the details of standard
SAP-recommended configuration steps for invoice and payables management. These
settings are made in the SAP S/4HANA system by following the customizing paths pro-
vided in the following sections for each step.
With SAP S/4HANA, it’s possible to take advantage of the SAP Best Practices activation
approach for customizing, as explained in Chapter 2. However, if you use the traditional
© 

505
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
customizing approach, this section can help. This information also helps validate the
SAP standard configuration.
This configuration section is divided into two areas: a set of configuration elements for
control of the entry of inbound invoices from suppliers, and a set of configuration ele-
ments controlling the circumstances by which entered invoices are blocked for subse-
quent processing. Here’s a list of available customizing activities for each:
 Configuration elements for managing incoming invoices
– Maintain Number Range Interval for Invoice Documents
– Assign Number Ranges to Invoicing Transactions
– Maintain Default Values for Tax Codes
– Configure How Unplanned Delivery Costs are Posted
– For GR-Based Invoice Verification, Reversal of GR Despite Invoice
– Set Check for Duplicate Invoices
– Activate Flexible Workflow for Supplier Invoices
– Define Document Life
 Configuration elements for managing invoice blocks
– Determine Payment Blocks
– Set Tolerance Limits
– Supplier-Specific Tolerances
– Activate Item Amount Check
– Set Item Amount Check
– Activate Stochastic Block
– Set Stochastic Block

sections.title: Configuration Elements for Managing Incoming Invoices
sections.text:
12.5.1 Configuration Elements for Managing Incoming Invoices
Let’s look at the configuration elements for managing incoming invoices. Here we’ll
cover number range intervals for invoice documents, number range assignment for
invoicing transactions, default values for tax codes, unplanned delivery cost configura-
tion, and more.
Maintain Number Range Interval for Invoice Documents
When an invoice document is created by SAP S/4HANA, it’s assigned a unique number
based on a preset number range in the system. If you wish to assign a different number
range to invoice documents, you need to establish a number range interval.
Navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Incoming
Invoice  Number Assignment  Maintain Number Assignment for Logistics Documents 

12 Invoice and Payables Management
506
Maintain Number Range for Invoice Documents. The Edit Intervals: Invoice Document
selection screen appears (see Figure 12.58).
Figure 12.58 Maintain Number Range for Invoice Documents: Selection Screen
Click the Change Intervals button. The Edit Intervals: Invoice Document screen appears
(see Figure 12.59).
Figure 12.59 Maintain Number Range for Invoice Documents: Maintenance Screen
Make any desired additions or changes to the standard number range intervals, then
press Save.
Note that number range configuration changes must be transported manually to the
target systems. Alternatively, you can maintain number range intervals or statuses
directly in the target system.
Assign Number Range to Invoicing Transactions
The number range then needs to be assigned to invoicing transactions. There are two
invoicing transactions in the SAP S/4HANA system: Transaction RD (Invoice Posting)
and Transaction RS (Invoice Cancellation, ERS, Invoicing Plan).
To assign number ranges to invoicing transactions, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials
Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Incoming Invoice  Number Assignment 
© 

507
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
Maintain Number Assignment for Logistics Documents  Transaction - Assign Number
Range. The Number Ranges: Logistics Invoice Verification screen appears (see Figure 12.60).
Figure 12.60 Transaction: Assign Number Range Screen
Assign the desired number range to the invoicing transactions, then press Save.
Maintain Default Values for Tax Codes
SAP S/4HANA can suggest a tax code that will default into an incoming domestic
invoice. This default tax code can be set by company code.
To assign default tax codes for invoices, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Manage-
ment  Logistics Invoice Verification  Incoming Invoice  Maintain Default Values for Tax
Codes. The Tax Defaults in Invoice Verification screen appears (see Figure 12.61).
Figure 12.61 Maintain Default Values for Tax Codes: Company Code Screen

12 Invoice and Payables Management
508
Click the checkbox next to the company code, then press the Details button. The Tax
Defaults in Invoice Verification—Company Code screen appears (see Figure 12.62).
Figure 12.62 Maintain Default Values for Tax Codes: Maintenance Screen
Use the dropdown list for the Tax Code field to select a valid tax code for the selected
company code. You can maintain default values for unplanned delivery costs as well.
When you’re done, press Save.
Configure How Unplanned Delivery Costs Are Posted
You can control how unplanned delivery costs that come in on a supplier invoice are
posted. You can either have the unplanned delivery costs distributed proportionally
over the invoice line items, or you can have them posted in a separate general ledger
account, one for each line item. This posting logic is set by company code.
To configure how unplanned delivery costs are posted, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Mate-
rials Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Incoming Invoice  Configure How
Unplanned Delivery Costs Are Posted. The Posting Delivery Costs screen appears (see
Figure 12.63).
Click the checkbox next to the company code, then select a valid unplanned delivery
cost option (blank for distribution across line items, 1 for posting to a separate general
ledger). When you’re done, press Save.
© 

509
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
Figure 12.63 Configure How Unplanned Delivery Costs Are Posted
For GR-Based Invoice Verification, Reversal of GR Despite Invoice
If your enterprise is using GR-based invoice verification, you can specify if you can
reverse a goods receipt or create a return delivery if the supplier invoice has already
been posted. If you don’t allow this option, the supplier invoice will need to be canceled
prior to entering the reversal or supplier return.
This setting is made by reversal or return movement type. It cannot be set by company
code.
To configure whether reversals or returns can be made after invoice posting, navigate
to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inven-
tory  Goods Receipt  For GR-Based IV, Reversal of GR Despite Invoice. The For GR-Based
IV, Reversal of GR Despite Invoice screen appears (see Figure 12.64).

12 Invoice and Payables Management
510
Figure 12.64 For GR-Based IV, Reversal of GR Despite Invoice Screen
Click the checkbox next to the movement types for which reversals or returns are
allowed without cancellation of the supplier invoice. When you’re done, press Save.
Set Check for Duplicate Invoices
With this configuration item, you can check that the same invoice is not inadvertently
entered into the SAP S/4HANA system more than once so that duplicate payments are
not made. The system can check that the supplier, currency code, company code, gross
invoice amount, reference document number, and invoice date are unique. These set-
tings apply to a company code.
To configure whether the system should check for duplicate invoices, navigate to IMG
(SPRO)  Materials Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Incoming Invoice  Set
Check for Duplicate Invoices. The Duplicate Invoice Check screen appears (see Figure
12.65).
For each company code, you can select if the system will check the company code, ref-
erence number, and/or invoice date during the duplicate invoice check. When you’re
done, press Save.
© 

511
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
Figure 12.65 Set Check for Duplicate Invoices Screen
Activate Flexible Workflow for Supplier Invoices
If you’d like SAP S/4HANA to use the flexible workflows available for approval of sup-
plier invoices, you’ll need to activate them in configuration. There are two flexible
workflows available:
 Workflow for Approval of Invoices on Payment Block
 Workflow to Release Completed Invoices for Payment
To configure whether the system uses the flexible workflow for supplier invoices, nav-
igate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Incoming
Invoice  Flexible Workflow for Supplier Invoices  Activate Flexible Workflow for Sup-
plier Invoices. The Activate Flexible Workflow for Supplier Invoices screen appears (see
Figure 12.66).
Click the checkbox for each flexible workflow you wish to use. When you’re done, press
Save.

12 Invoice and Payables Management
512
Figure 12.66 Activate Flexible Workflow for Supplier Invoices Screen
Define Document Life
Enterprises often implement an archiving system in their SAP S/4HANA systems for
business objects, including supplier invoices. The amount of time that an enterprise
requires objects to be available online is typically determined by document retention
policies. You can use this configuration item to prevent the accidental archiving of sup-
plier invoices before a certain number of days. This setting is based on the company
code.
The menu path to set the document life is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Logis-
tics Invoice Verification  Define Document Life. The MR Document Archiving: Docu-
ment Life screen appears (see Figure 12.67).
Figure 12.67 Define Document Life Screen
Edit the number of days for the specified company code, then press Save.
© 

513
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management

sections.title: Configuration Elements for Managing Invoice Blocks
sections.text:
12.5.2 Configuration Elements for Managing Invoice Blocks
Let’s take a look at the configuration elements for managing invoice blocks. We’ll begin
with determining payment blocks, setting tolerance limits, and defining supplier-spe-
cific tolerances. Then we’ll activate item amount checks, set item amount checks, and
do the same for stochastic blocks.
Determine Payment Blocks
You can create payment block reasons to suit your enterprise’s requirements. These
can be manually applied to the invoice at the time of entry.
The menu path to create payment block codes is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management 
Logistics Invoice Verification  Invoice Block  Determine Payment Blocks. The Reasons
for Blocking Payment screen appears (see Figure 12.68).
Figure 12.68 Determine Payment Block Screen
Click New Entries to create a new blocking code and description. When you’re finished,
press Save.
Set Tolerance Limits
The SAP S/4HANA system checks each invoice item for variances between the invoice
and the purchase order and goods receipt. Each variance is defined as a tolerance key.
Each company code has its own set of tolerance keys that can be configured. The sys-
tem uses the following tolerance keys and settings during invoice processing:

12 Invoice and Payables Management
514
 AN: Amount for item without order reference
 AP: Amount for item with order reference
 BD: Form small differences automatically
 BR: Percentage OPUn (order price unit) variance (IR before GR)
 BW: Percentage OPUn variance (GR before IR)
 DQ: Exceed amount: quantity variance
 DW: Quantity variance when GR qty = zero
 KW: Var. from condition value
 PP: Price variance
 PS: Price variance: estimated price
 ST: Date variance (value x days)
 VP: Moving average price variance
If a variance exceeds a tolerance limit, the user receives a message. If an upper limit is
exceeded, then the invoice will be blocked for payment. Refer to the configuration help
documentation for detailed explanations of each tolerance key and how they work.
The menu path to set tolerance limits is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Logistics
Invoice Verification  Invoice Block  Set Tolerance Limits. The Tolerance Limits screen
appears (see Figure 12.69).
Figure 12.69 Set Tolerance Limits Screen
Click the checkbox next to the company code and tolerance key combination you wish
to maintain, then press the Details button. The screens shown will depend on the toler-
ance key being maintained. Change the tolerance settings based on your requirements.
When you’re finished, press Save.
© 

515
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
Supplier-Specific Tolerances
There are some tolerances that can be applied to specific suppliers in a company code
if you wish. This is done using a tolerance group. You define tolerance groups per com-
pany code, then assign them to suppliers via the business partner vendor maintenance
screens. You can configure how the system reacts to certain variances that occur, both
positive and negative. Refer to the configuration help documentation for detailed
explanations of each tolerance setting and how they work. The menu path to set sup-
plier-specific tolerances is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Logistics Invoice Veri-
fication  Incoming Invoice  Configure Supplier-Specific Tolerances. The Supplier-
Specific Tolerances Company Code Selection screen appears (see Figure 12.70).
Figure 12.70 Supplier-Specific Tolerances: Company Code Selection Screen
Click the checkbox next to the company code and tolerance group you wish to main-
tain. Click the New Entries field to create a new company code and tolerance group
combination. The Supplier-Specific Tolerances Details screen appears (see Figure 12.71).
Figure 12.71 Supplier-Specific Tolerances: Maintenance Screen

12 Invoice and Payables Management
516
Maintain the tolerance limits and settings. When you’re finished, press Save.
Activate Item Amount Check
You can instruct the SAP S/4HANA system to block an invoice line item that exceeds a
specified amount. You activate this check using this configuration item. The check is
set by company code.
The menu path to activate the item amount check is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Manage-
ment  Logistics Invoice Verification  Invoice Block  Item Amount Check  Activate Item
Amount Check. The Activate Block Due to Item Amount screen appears (see Figure
12.72).
Figure 12.72 Activate Item Amount Check Screen
Click the Check Item Amount checkbox for the company code in question to activate
the item amount check. When you’re finished, press Save.
© 

517
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
Set Item Amount Check
In this configuration item, you set for each combination of company code, item cate-
gory, and goods receipt indicator whether the item amount check should take place.
Note that the upper limit (the value above which the system should block the invoice
line) is maintained in the Set Tolerance Limits configuration item discussed previously
(tolerance keys AN [item amount check without order reference] and AP [item amount
check with order reference]).
The menu path to activate the item amount check is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Manage-
ment  Logistics Invoice Verification  Invoice Block  Item Amount Check  Set Item
Amount Check. The Invoice Verification Amount Check screen appears (see Figure 12.73).
Figure 12.73 Set Item Amount Check Screen
Maintain all combinations of company code, item category, and goods receipt indica-
tor for which the item amount check should be active. When you’re finished, press
Save.

12 Invoice and Payables Management
518
Activate Stochastic Block
The system provides the capability for randomly blocking invoices for further review
and approval. This capability is known as stochastic blocking. You enable stochastic
blocking by company code.
The menu path to activate the stochastic block is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management 
Logistics Invoice Verification  Invoice Block  Stochastic Block  Activate Stochastic
Block. The Stochastic Block Activation screen appears (see Figure 12.74).
Figure 12.74 Activate Stochastic Block Screen
Click the Stochastic Block checkbox for the correct company code to activate the sto-
chastic block capability. When you’re finished, press Save.
Set Stochastic Block
In this configuration item, you set the threshold and percentage values that determine
how likely it is that the stochastic blocking will happen. If the total invoice value is
greater than or equal to the threshold value, the probability that the invoice will be
© 

519
12.5 Configuring Invoice and Payables Management
blocked is the same as the percentage. However, if the total invoice value is less than
the threshold value, the probability that the invoice will be blocked is proportional to
the given percentage. This guarantees that invoices less than the threshold are blocked
less often than ones that warrant further review. Stochastic checks are performed after
all other invoice block checks are complete. You set stochastic blocking thresholds and
percentages by company code.
The menu path to activate the stochastic block is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management 
Logistics Invoice Verification  Invoice Block  Stochastic Block  Set Stochastic Block. The
Stochastic Block Values screen appears (see Figure 12.75).
Figure 12.75 Set Stochastic Block Screen
Enter the threshold invoice value and probability of blocking in the fields provided for
each company code that was activated in the previous configuration item. When you’re
finished, press Save.

12 Invoice and Payables Management
520

sections.title: Integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Invoice Management by
sections.text:
12.6 Integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Invoice Management by
OpenText
SAP Invoice Management by OpenText is an invoice management and processing soft-
ware solution that is fully integrated with SAP S/4HANA. Companies use the solution
to simplify the process of receiving, managing, routing, and monitoring supplier
invoices, from receipt to posting.
Note
SAP Invoice Management by OpenText is not included with SAP S/4HANA and requires
a separate software license.
SAP Invoice Management by OpenText has an optical character recognition (OCR)
engine called Intelligent Capture that can scan and digitize invoice documents received
via email or in the mail. It can read information from these invoices and map that
information to the correct fields in SAP S/4HANA. Validations are also managed, and if
the document contains errors, these parked documents can be routed to the proper
individual for further processing. This helps minimize time-consuming manual data
entry and the errors associated with that practice.
The software also has integrated machine learning built in, which improves capture accu-
racy based on the corrections made by the user. Once the invoice is successfully pro-
cessed, it is linked to the SAP supplier invoice document and can be pulled up at any time.
SAP Invoice Management by OpenText also contains rules that can route invoices for
approval based on your company’s criteria. Rules managing invoice processing situa-
tions and invoice approval routing can be set up. It also has an audit trail for all actions
taken within the application so that you can see the status of the routing at any time.
The software does optimize and automate the processing of supplier invoices and cred-
its. This helps in maximizing the no-touch rate for invoices, which in turn allows com-
panies to take better advantage of early payment discounts. SAP Invoice Management
by OpenText also has country-specific rules and check formats built in, making it suit-
able for projects with international scope.
Once an invoice is posted via SAP Invoice Management by OpenText, it is passed onto
accounts payable for payment processing.
The software uses the same SAP Fiori interface as SAP S/4HANA (see Figure 12.76). This
use of SAP Fiori makes adoption and training of SAP Invoice Management by OpenText
easier and allows for invoice processing and approvals on any device that supports SAP
Fiori, including mobile phones and tablets.
In summary, SAP Invoice Management by OpenText automates the capture and rout-
ing of supplier invoices for processing and approval, increasing the no-touch rate and
making invoice entry quicker and less error-prone, resulting in a reduction of costs in
the procure-to-pay process.
© 

521

sections.title: SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management for SAP S/4HANA Cloud
sections.text:
12.7 SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management for SAP S/4HANA Cloud
Figure 12.76 SAP Invoice Management by OpenText Accounts Payable Workplace App
12.7 SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management for SAP S/4HANA Cloud
SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management for SAP S/4HANA Cloud is a centralized system
for uploading, processing, and managing invoice images and distributing them to con-
nected systems for further processing. Currently, SAP S/4HANA, S/4HANA Cloud, and
SAP ERP connected systems are supported. SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management is
built on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) and utilizes the SAP Fiori user
interface.
Note
SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management is not a part of SAP S/4HANA and does require
a separate subscription license.
There are two apps used for SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management:
 Upload Supplier Invoices
 Manage Supplier Invoices Centrally

sections.title: Upload Supplier Invoices
sections.text:
12.7.1 Upload Supplier Invoices
The Upload Supplier Invoices app is used to process inbound invoice images into draft
invoice documents in SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management. Invoice images to be
processed are manually selected and uploaded into SAP Ariba Central Invoice Manage-
ment. The system then assigns a unique central invoice document number to each
uploaded image and places the document into Draft status. Image formats supported
are PDF, PNG, TIFF, and JPG.

12 Invoice and Payables Management
522
OCR processing then matches the information in the uploaded image to specific fields
in the supplier invoice document. If all required fields can be matched, then the invoice
document is submitted to the connected system, where a verification job is run to val-
idate the data. If no errors are found, a supplier invoice document is created and posted
in the connected system. If errors are found, the document is returned to SAP Ariba
Central Invoice Management, where a user can view the invoice image to find the infor-
mation needed to successfully create the document.

sections.title: Manage Supplier Invoices Centrally
sections.text:
12.7.2 Manage Supplier Invoices Centrally
The Manage Supplier Invoices Centrally app allows users to browse a list of invoices
that have been processed in SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management. Filtering and sort-
ing options allow you to refine the list and find a specific invoice document quickly.
You can use this list to view the results of an upload and perform further processing on
the draft invoices if required. Each centrally managed invoice document and associ-
ated image file are available for viewing or processing.
The status of the incoming invoice is set using the following rules:
 If the incoming invoice is processed successfully in the connected system, the status
is changed to Posted.
 If errors are found during verification, then the With Errors status is assigned. You
can open the invoice in the connected system and make corrections as needed.
 If required fields are missing during scanning, then the status remains set to Draft.
You can open the invoice in SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management to view its
image and mapped fields and make corrections as needed. Once corrected, the sys-
tem will create a parked invoice in the connected system.
There is an SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation bot available through the SAP
RPA Store that can read through supplier emails and extract supplier invoice attach-
ments in different formats, then automatically upload them to SAP Ariba Central
Invoice Management for creation of draft invoices.
There are several other administrative apps in SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management
that allow a user to import master data and supplier data into SAP Ariba Central Invoice
Management, schedule upload jobs for invoice images and master data, manage autho-
rizations, and administer connected systems.

sections.title: Taulia: Working Capital Management
sections.text:
12.8 Taulia: Working Capital Management
Enterprises are always looking for ways to make their supply chains more resilient and
stable, especially when supply chain disruptions and higher inflation put increased
pressure on their operations. Finding ways to unlock cash that is locked up in working
© 

523
12.8 Taulia: Working Capital Management
capital can be an effective strategy for dealing with these challenges. SAP has acquired
Taulia, a company specializing in working capital management. SAP has integrated
Taulia with SAP S/4HANA Finance for treasury and risk management and SAP Business
Network to provide an end-to-end solution for managing working capital to inject
liquidity and liberate cash locked up in working capital.
All three components work together in the following ways:
 SAP S/4HANA (treasury/accounts payable) helps plan, analyze cash management,
and control risk.
 SAP Business Network enables collaboration between buyers and sellers.
 Taulia’s solutions for working capital management analyze, onboard business part-
ners, and execute working capital–optimization programs.
Finance leaders want to optimize their working capital by gaining visibility into and
access to their cash and liquidity, receivables, payables, and inventory. They also want
to unlock cash locked up in working capital to fund existing business operations or
new ventures.
Taulia provides several solutions to assist with these challenges:
 With Taulia Dynamic Discounting, suppliers are offered early payment, allowing
you to earn a risk-free return via discounts.
 Taulia Supply Chain Finance enables increased cash flow for suppliers by using
third-party-funded reverse factoring.
 Taulia Inventory provides supply chain assurance and mitigates the inherent risk of
extended lead times, stock outages, and missed sales.
 Taulia Receivables Finance enables the enterprise to receive early payment on cus-
tomer invoices, reducing days sales outstanding.
Taulia contains embedded analytics, which helps guide the enterprise toward improv-
ing the performance of working capital programs. It also is linked to partner banks and
financial institutions, which provide the funding required to obtain cash when needed.
The Taulia platform has been integrated with SAP Business Network, which enables
you to collaborate with your trading partners and financing partners to provide pro-
grams to accelerate cashflow and optimize financials.
Many additional innovations are on the Taulia roadmap, including the following:
 Virtual cards for immediate payment via SAP Business Network
 Preapproved invoice financing
 Embedded finance insights
 A working capital planner and modeling

12 Invoice and Payables Management
524

sections.title: Summary
sections.text:
12.9 Summary
You’ve now learned that SAP S/4HANA provides a complete solution for managing the
entry and processing of supplier invoices into the SAP S/4HANA system. Once the
invoice data is entered and verified in the system, control then passes to accounts pay-
able for supplier payment. There are many reporting and analytic apps that allow
accounts payable personnel to monitor and optimize the invoicing and payment pro-
cess from end to end. Now, let’s look at supplier management.
©
